206004.description:
Episode 1 - Episode 2 part 1 - Ayase Gal wa Boku ni Muchuu: Okaa-san mo Maze nasai yo
Ayase Miki, a gal student on the verge of repeating a year, ignores her homeroom teacher Sakurai Makoto's warnings. Realizing the situation won't improve without involving her parents, Sakurai pays a home visit. There, he's greeted by her busty mother, Minami. Instead of listening seriously, the mother and daughter start competing, each claiming her own body is better.

Episode 2 part 2 - Totte Torarete Shirokuro Gal Shimai♥
A loser living alone gets caught stealing underwear left out to dry by his neighbors, who film him and storm into his apartment. The neighbors—a pair of black-and-white gal sisters (Yukino and Natsuno)—demand he take a photo of his dick as part of a settlement. But seeing something bigger than they expected, the two get excited and...

(Source: Mediabank, translated)

206038.description:
Step into the world of Catch! Teenieping like never before—where speed meets sparkle and friendship fuels the finish line. In this special animated spin-off, Hyundai introduces Heartsping and Hoppingping, two rookie racers joining their very first racing team!

Note: Premiered as part of the Youth Adventure 2025 exhibition at the Hyundai Motorstudio in Goyang, Korea

title.romaji: Banjjakineun Ujeong Racing: Racer Hachuupinggwa Kkangchongpingui Tansaeng

206048.description:
Long ago, there lived a young man named Yosuke in the village of Shiiba in Hyuuga.

"I want enough money and possessions to live a luxurious life without having to work"

Yohei abandoned his job in his impoverished village, where only barnyard millet, oxtail millet and beans could be grown. He fled into the mountains, where one night he witnessed a strange sight.

A blue ogre clinging to a large cedar tree split its back, began to shed its skin and quickly transformed into a red ogre. Yosuke stole the shed skin, wore it and began committing crimes in the village.

However, when he tried to take off the skin, he couldn't get it off no matter what he did...

(Source: Official Website, translated)

206051.description: Independent pilot film to the series Dungeons & Television.

title.native: ダンジョン＆テレビジョン パイロットフィルム

206054.description:
Music video directed and animated by Ryuu Katou for the song Aporia by Yorushika.

Note: The song featured in this music video also serves as the first ending theme of the anime Chi. Chikyuu no Undou ni Tsuite.

206056.description:
Music video directed and animated by Miyo Satou for the song Hebi by Yorushika.

Note: The song featured in this music video also serves as the second ending theme of the anime Chi. Chikyuu no Undou ni Tsuite.

206059.description: Music video directed by StudioXD for the song BAZUBI BAZAB by Towa Tokoyami

206066.description:
Adapted from the most outstanding collection of Chinese classical short stories.

Pu Songling, a scholar, stays overnight at Lanruo Temple. He is caught by two monsters, Toad and Turtle, and brought to the bottom of an ancient well to judge the quality of his stories.

In a temple, a well, and a tree, classic chapters of Strange Stories, such as The Taoist Priest of Mount Laoshan, Lotus Princess, Nie Xiaoqian, Painted Skin, and Lady Lu, unfold one after another across the vicissitudes of life. Six story styles present an audio-visual feast of the most bizarre stories, the most emotional and the most fateful.

206071.description:
Ordinary life repeats itself every day. The succession of moments that we repeat over and over again is never the same, and everything changes and wavers. The moment we touch something, our consciousness can go to a place that does not exist anywhere in the past, nor in the future. In an uncertain and fluctuating world, only the feeling of the body touching something, which exists only in this present reality, can be recognized as “now”. That moment is lovely.

(Source: YouTube description)

Note: Premiered at the 75th Berlin International Film Festival on February 15, 2025

206074.description:
A natural disaster, the Purple Magic Orchid grows wantonly in the valley where humans live. It can cause people to sink and even lose their lives. Only Hua Qiangu survived because of the protection of the Flower God Tree, but the baby infected with the Purple Magic Orchid poison brought by the mythical beast Phoenix from outside the valley broke the peace of Hua Qiangu.

The king and queen of Hua Qiangu violated the ancestral precepts of Hua Qiangu not to allow outsiders to enter and took in the baby, named Princess Peony, and raised her to thrive.

The Flower God Tree suddenly withered, and Princess Peony fell ill, which made Hua Qiangu suspicious of all living beings, and they petitioned the king to send Princess Peony away. The queen could not give up the mother-daughter relationship, and sought help from the Flower God Tree. She volunteered to sacrifice herself to go to the black enchantment to experience the calamity and let the flower soul come back, but due to the powerful power of the Purple Magic Orchid, the queen was trapped and never returned.

Ten years later, Peony grew up, the Purple Magic Orchid made a comeback, and Hua Qiangu encountered an unprecedented disaster. Princess Peony remembered the queen's teachings and embarked on an adventure with the flower soul seeds to save Hua Qiangu.

title.romaji: Hua Qian Gu: Hua Hun Zhi Lu

206140.description: The film is based on Chinese mythology such as Journey to the West, bringing together numerous gods and goddesses to tell the legendary story of low-ranking gods who defy fate and change their destiny in a chaotic world where faith has collapsed.

206142.description: Tang San and Xiao Wu return to the collapsed Slaughter City, now devastated by the Snow Swan Kiss. They face relentless pursuit from the mutated Slaughter King, only to be saved by a mysterious girl whose rescue conceals dark secrets. Together, Tang San and Xiao Wu must uncover the truth behind Slaughter City's corruption.

206145.description:
Following a decline in the amount of monster movies created, Meng Qi, a director who is obsessed with the monster movie genre, becomes unsure about his persistence—he never expected that one day an actual monster would appear in front of him! In order to fulfill his dream, Meng Qi decides to cooperate with the demon girl Liya and help her shoot a demon themed movie. However, as the shooting progresses, Meng Qi discovers that things in the other world are closely related to him...

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Kai Pai La! Guaishou Da Dianying

206151.description: In this fantasy world, where everyone is human and retains their animal features, the inhabitants live a peaceful life. For his next book, novelist Su Bai comes to the hometown of his good friend Avena Nanxia, a terraced village far away in the mountains, where he meets the lively and lovely Cu Nian Nian. Farming, picking, eating, catching fish ...... The daily life in the mountains and fields is always interesting.

title.native: 启运丹田：开局签到至尊丹田
title.romaji: Qiyun Dantian: Kaiju Qiandao Zhizun Dantian

206158.description:
The Fairies Xia Letong, Yan Keke and Bai Yinyue, along with their Transfer Elf partners Buding, Milu and Lubi awaken the Garden of Spirit Spring, Island of Fantastical Summer and Park of Warm Autumn which contains the energy of the four seasons. Taking up the role of guardians, they must maintain the balance of the four seasons.

However, Siqi, the guardian of the Cliffs of Frigid Winter was deceived, and now intends to freeze over the other three seasons, to restore the order of Frigid Winter.

While the fairies guard the four season, they experience all kinds of trouble. In the process, they must learn to accept themselves, tolerate others and look at problems more comprehensively. At the same time, they will deepen their bonds with one another. In the end, their courage and understanding will turn defeat into victory and resolve the winter crisis!

title.native: 巴啦啦小魔仙之星緣蝶啓1
title.romaji: Balala Xiao Mo Xian: Xing Yuan Die Qi 1

title.native: 巴啦啦小魔仙之星缘蝶启2
title.romaji: Balala Xiao Mo Xian: Xing Yuan Die Qi 2

206160.description: The second season of Yun Shen Buzhi Meng.

206163.description:
The story of Armored Trooper VOTOMS: Die Graue Hexe is set during the final stages of the Hundred Year War between Gilgamesh and Balarant that ravaged the Astragius Galaxy. Against this backdrop, army officer Maki Staufenberg is assigned to Valkyria II, the second planet in the Asgard system, where she is tasked with investigating Ash Vamps, a soldier who has earned the nickname of “Witch” because of her habit of being the sole survivor in missions assigned to her ragtag band of soldiers on punishment detail.

(Source: Crunchyroll News)

Note: Relations are provisional and subject to change.

Armored Trooper Votoms: The Grey Witch
Soukou Kihei Votoms: Haiiro no Majo

title.romaji: Soukou Kihei Votoms: Haiiro no Hexe

206166.description:
It's a place where greedy wives live... A married woman's erotic suspense!

This is the extreme suspense of a married woman by the author of Libido Hunter Takeru! In this story, a group of perverted married women wearing the mysterious "libido cross" costume that amplifies human desires come under attack! Protect the apartment complex from the threat of perverted wives, new janitor Yoshida!

206193.description:
The Ye family was suddenly massacred—Ye Beichen's parents and brothers were slaughtered, and he himself was ruthlessly thrown into the moat, clinging to life by a thread. Rescued by his senior sister, he was taken to Kunlun Mountain, where he spent five grueling years mastering martial arts. Five years later, he returned in full force, armed with the peerless skills taught by 99 invincible masters. Back in the mortal world, when faced with old enemies and powerful factions, Ye Beichen showed no fear. With extraordinary martial prowess and overwhelming strength, he unleashed chaos across the city, carving a path of revenge and dominance—turning the tables and crushing all who once sought his downfall.

(Source: Youku, translated)

title.native: 徒儿你无敌了下山去吧
title.romaji: Tuer Ni Wudile Xiashan Qu Ba

206194.description: The second season of Zhan Shen: Fanchen Shen Yu.

title.native: 斩神之凡尘神域 第2季

206195.description:
The Pure Sea's currents flow from north to south, constantly flowing through this world. People build homes and thrive on the backs of giant beasts. Every wish has its response. The deity known as Fan Ying warns that only by letting your wishes run wild can you reap the rewards of miracles and survive. However, the unchanging rules are about to change, and those who transcend fate will eventually follow the origin of all things.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

206212.description: The third season of Huo Feng Liao Yuan.

206215.description: The seventh season of Wu Dong Qiankun.

206223.description: Since ancient times, the magical inhabitants of the seas have been under the protection of fairies who use the mystical Dance of the Wind to scare away evil. Over the years, magic began to fade, and magical creatures began to disappear. Now, the last of its kind in China can only be saved by a young fairy named Lin, who must find someone to share the Wind Dance with and hide a unique creature from poachers.

206244.description: The third season of Luo Xiaohei Zhan Ji.

title.native: 罗小黑战记 学前篇
title.romaji: Luo Xiaohei Zhan Ji: Xue Qian Pian

206249.description: The year 1910. Iwamoto Kodou is a young boy who has successfully carried out many curious missions under the military's directive. His destinations lead to encounters with the strange, weaving tales of history that have yet to be told.

206250.description: Music video directed by syo5 for the song Ittai Itsukara by Hatsuboshi Gakuen's Temari Tsukimura (Nao Ojika).

206256.description:
Dongfang Shaohong, possessing two Dao bodies, but lacking the spiritual roots to awaken his spirit body, is ridiculed by his own clan and even betrayed by his fiancée. Troubles pile up one after another. Dongfang Shaohong's father, imprisoned for possessing the secret to entering the Cangyu Immortal Palace, is trapped by the Immortal Alliance. In the midst of his clan's crisis, Dongfang Shaohong inadvertently uses his own blood to activate the Dao Stone of Immortal Source within him, repelling the Immortal Alliance and saving the clan from the brink. In these dire straits, Dongfang Shaohong is fortunately rescued by his father's friend, Master Ji Yin, and is offered refuge within the Piaomiao Sect. Within the Taiyin Mountain ravine of the Piaomiao Sect, Dongfang Shaohong diligently cultivates, but possessing the Dark Night Dao Body of the Nether Clan is viewed as an anomaly among the human race and constantly harassed by his fellow disciples. Dongfang Shaohong realizes that only by becoming powerful enough can he rescue his father, clear his name, and expose the Immortal Alliance's conspiracy.

(Source: Bangumi, translated)
synonyms: Legend of the Misty Sword Immortal

206266.description: Hover Champs tells the story of some boys who compete in remote-controlled helicopters: Matthew and Zoe. Matthew is a 13-year-old boy who returns, with his mother, to the town where he was born. There he meets Zoe, a girl with great ability to drive remote-controlled helicopters. Matthew manages, on the first day, to break Zoe's record and she proposes that he form a team to compete together.

title.romaji: Lei Su Deng: Yi Fei Chong Tian

206270.description: The third season of Cang Yuan Tu.

206272.description:
Luolan Mansion, one of the five major mansions of Daxia in Shenzhou Continent, has fallen into decline due to the mysterious disappearance of two mansion masters. Although the young mansion master Li Luo is extremely talented and was born with three phase palaces, he has difficulty practicing because of his natural empty phase.

Jiang Qinge, with whom he had been engaged since childhood, has a ninth-grade light phase and is extremely talented. Realizing the gap between them, Li Luo wanted to cancel the contract and break off the engagement, but was rejected by Jiang Qinge.

On his seventeenth birthday, Li Luo took away the secret treasure left by his parents and obtained the water light phase, but the price was that his hair turned white overnight and his life was overdrawn. If he wanted to extend his life, he had to reach the state of a marquis within five years.

206273.description:
In the darkest moment of Celestial Realm, the crippled youth Gu An seized the power of an ancient god amid life-or-death peril. Wielding infinite spiritual energy and a mortal blade, he destroyed evildoers, avenged deep grudges, and struck down the heavens.

(Source: Youku)

206274.description:
To resist invasions from other worlds, the Heavenly Great Sage founded Tianguan Academy. Every year, the Academy would recruit new students—but in the end, only nine could become the official Heavenly Officers. Gu Tian, a young soccer player, accidentally awakened his hidden power while saving someone on the field. Invited by his senior Xia Zhi, he boarded Subway Line 36 to Tianguan Academy. With the world's finest teachers, strict assessments, and a brutal elimination system, the Academy pushes its students to the limit. By a stroke of fortune, Gu Tian became the 81st student to pass the entrance trial. Under the guidance of celestial masters, he studied spells and divine decrees, honed his combat skills against powerful rivals, and strode forward step by step toward the ultimate goal of becoming one of the Nines.

(Source: Youku, translated)

206275.description:
Zhu Ning, a warrior who slayed in all directions in a zombie apocalypse, unexpectedly dies and is transported to a wasteland filled with unknowns and fantasy. She becomes a fifth-class citizen, the lowest rank in the world, forced to make a living by "scavenging garbage." However, she discovers the strangeness and danger of this world in her work: various bizarre polluting monsters, the world's strange operating rules, and even her own strange self… Zhu Ning gradually uncovers a huge secret hidden behind the world, which also brings her immense danger. In this unknown post-apocalyptic world, Zhu Ning is forced into complex conflicts, searching for the truth about herself and the world.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Wo Zai Feitu Shijie Sao Laji

206276.description:
In an out-of-control world, survivors faced a thrilling and perilous apocalyptic battlefield.

(Source: Youku, translated)

206277.description:
"I came from the wilderness, raised by five incredibly powerful grandparents. To uncover the truth behind my parents' murder, I return to the city."

Watch as this young hero, skilled in martial arts, music, chess, medicine, and cooking, feigns weakness to outsmart others, surrounded by beautiful women, rises against all odds, solves a shocking mystery, and vows to become the city's all-around master, the undisputed ruler of this land!

(Source: iQIYI, translated)

206282.description:
Once hailed as the third-strongest expert on the Tianwu Continent, Martial Emperor Gu Feiyang found his cultivation trapped at its peak by the very laws of the world. To break through his limits, he orchestrated an audacious plan, sacrificing everything to reincarnate and begin anew.

Reborn as Li Yunxiao, a fifteen-year-old heir of a powerful military family in the Kingdom of Tianshui, he finds himself caught in a storm of invasion, royal succession struggles, and political intrigue. While others fight for power and status, Li Yunxiao sees the bigger picture. Armed with the wisdom and experience of a former Martial Emperor, he calmly overcomes every obstacle on his path toward a single goal: completing the grand design he began in his previous life and laying the foundation for true godhood.

(Source: Bilibili TV)

206283.description:
Nuclear winter descends, civilization collapses, and humanity is no longer the master of the world. To protect themselves, humans have built one fortress after another, while beyond the walls, survival comes only through blood and fire.

Ren Xiaosu and his younger brother Yan Liuyuan are among those left outside. Once ordinary boys of the wilderness, they have no shelter and nowhere to run. The only thing they can rely on is each other. When a massive earthquake strikes Jingshan, Fortress 113 comes crashing down, laying bare the chaos of the post-apocalyptic world. During their escape, Ren Xiaosu and his family rescue Luo Lan, a military leader, and make their way into Fortress 109. A new life seems about to begin, but the real trials have only just started…

(Source: Bilibili TV)

206284.description: Pan Gaofeng, a young rocket development engineer born in the 1980s, joined the First Academy of Aerospace Science and Technology, the cradle of my country's launch vehicles, after graduating from graduate school. He was fortunate to be a member of the development team for the Long March 5 (CZ-5), my country's most powerful launch vehicle. Working alongside his predecessors and colleagues, he overcame numerous difficulties, overcame obstacles, and defied external ridicule and skepticism. He rose from the ashes of a failed launch to ultimately achieve success, marking a crucial step in my country's transition from a major space power to a leading space power.

206287.description: The young human Wang Dong vowed to avenge his parents and joined the Storm Squad, determined to exterminate the Zhage insect species across the solar system. Through hardships, he awakened his Blade Warrior powers, upgraded his armor and skills, and ultimately uncovered the insects' ultimate plot on Earth along with his team. Facing overwhelming swarms, Wang activated his ultimate Blade Warrior form and defeated both human traitors and the insect leader Ying Yuan.

206289.description: After a magnetic storm strikes the Blue Star Continent, spiritual energy is revived, transforming both humans and animals. This triggers a battle for survival between spirit beasts and humans. Ling Tian, a young prodigy with an ancient divine bloodline and a treasure called the 'God Brain,' discovers that in three years, the continent will face a disaster that will lead to his heroic death. Guided by Yan Ling, his assistant from the future, he embarks on a mission to attain ultimate power and change the continent's fate.

206290.description:
Darkest night falls as the sun sets in the west, only to rise again in the east. Such is the destiny of each new dawn.

(Source: Honkai Star Rail YouTube Channel)
synonyms: 崩壊：スターレイル 朝日の運命
Houkai: Star Rail - Asahi no Unmei
Bunggoe: Star Rail - Achim Haeui Unmyeong

title.english: Honkai: Star Rail  — The Destiny of Each New Dawn
title.native: 崩坏：星穹铁道 一轮朝阳的命运
title.romaji: Benghuai: Xingqiong Tiedao - Yilun Zhaoyang de Mingyun

206292.description:
One day, Li Wuwang suddenly awakens to find himself, as the villain, kidnapping Wan Zheng, the Holy Maiden of the Wan Chao Sect, and fleeing. Before Li Wuwang can even react, the "system" that appears before him quickly issues him a mission: strip the Destiny Points of the chosen one. Either complete the mission and survive, or fail and become an ant dying under the sword of the chosen protagonist.

(Source: Youku, translated)
synonyms: The Public Enemy of the Immortal World

title.native: 劇場版 メダリスト

Graduation work of Fumika Satou at Kanazawa College of Art.

Graduate Work 2019, Kanazawa College of Art, Graduate Visual Communication Design, Department of Design

206352.description: Music video directed by Youhei Kameyama for the song until i die by konore.

206353.description:
The boxfish has no confidence in himself, he always spends his time alone on the rocks watching the other fish, feeling envious.

"Everyone else is so lucky. All I do is float back and forth in the same place on these rocks every day..."

Then one day, he meets a lost sea horse who seems to have come from the Minamata ocean, he then decides to embark on his first ever adventure to return the fish to the Minamata's sea...

(Source: Official Website, translated)

title.english: The Boxfish and the Sea of Minamata
title.native: ハコフグとみなまたの海

206362.description:
Music video directed by Ayume Kuroshima for the song One Last Wish by DADA GAUGUIN.

Note: There exists 2 versions of this song, the original sung by DADA GAUGUIN released on July 12, 2025, and a SynthV version featuring Kasane Teto released on Aug 1, 2025. The SynthV version features other visuals as well.

206401.description:
University student Kurumi Fukuga has finally fulfilled her long-held desire of starting foreign exchange (FX) trading, motivated by recouping the 20 million yen her late mother lost in trading. "I'll easily make it back," she thought, but the world she enters can become heaven or hell in an instant. Unrealized losses, loss-cutting, unstoppable fluctuations… but she still wants to buy, sell and make money! With fellow FX addicts Mochiko, Mebuki and Yasuko along for the ride, the market heats up! Joy, despair, joy, despair — this is an endearing, yet slightly risky money game. Can Kurumi and her friends survive this turbulent world?

(Source: Crunchyroll)

206425.description:

title.romaji: Sousou no Frieren: ●● no Mahou Part 3

206500.description:
Tall, blonde and blue-eyed, it is impossible not to notice Isak Borg, First Secretary to the Swedish Embassy in Pyongyang. As a diplomat, he is under constant surveillance and strongly discouraged from interacting with the locals. Despite this, he secretly dates Bok-joo, a local traffic officer, but when one last effort to extend his stay is rejected, Isak begs her to come back to Stockholm with him. Bok-joo turns this idea down and abruptly disappears. Oblivious to the danger he is putting the woman he loves in, Isak asks Myeong-jun, his assigned interpreter, for help. When Myeong-jun refuses, a desperate Isak becomes increasingly suspicious of everyone.

(Source: Tribeca Film)

206516.description: Commercial directed by Ryouchimo made for Explore France's 2024 tourism campaign.
206516.hashtag: #私を知らないフランスに会いに行く #フランス

title.native: 私を知らないフランスに会いに行く
title.romaji: Watashi wo Shiranai France ni Ai ni Iku

206517.description:
The story is set in the galaxy located near the center of the universe.

There are Planet Aernia (a planet for Heroes) and Planet Orbs (a planet for robots), governed by Orbiton, in this same galaxy.

Various countries are present in Planet Aernia; they are, Volculm (volcanic country of fire), Zylan (oceanic country of water), Elvan (green-rich country of forest), and Aleum (celestial country of clouds).

Antania, is a nucleus of all the present countries. It has an academy that fosters Heroes.

Under the reign of the Governor General, Antania upholds a national policy to train Heroes to prevent Planet Aernia to be infringed by the Dark Desire.

Heroes are not only the reliable source of battle who have special abilities to freely use the battle discs, but also a symbol of unfailing justice.
synonyms: HEROES(ヒーローズ)～Legend of Battle Disks～
Heroes: A Lenda dos Discos de Batalha

title.native: ヒーローズ ～バトルディスク伝説～

206519.description: Epilogue to Neppuu Kairiku Bushi Road included with the Blu-ray release.
synonyms: 熱風海陸ブシロード エピローグ

title.native: 熱風海陸ブシロード 希望への道
title.romaji: Neppuu Kairiku Bushi Road: Kibou e no Michi

206521.description:
Born into a life of acting and dance with a traveling theater troupe in 14th-century Japan, 12-year old Oniyasha has one problem—he doesn't know what the point of any of it is. "Why must I step with the left foot here instead of the right? Why is one performance good and another, bad? Why do people dance at all?" It all seems perfectly arbitrary, until a chance encounter in a run-down shack sets him down a path to revolutionizing the art form and influencing much of Japanese culture to come. A fictionalized account of the early life of Zeami Motokiyo (Oniyasha), the founder of modern Noh theater—the world's oldest surviving theater art—this coming-of-age artist's journey vividly brings to life a man far ahead of his time during one of Japan's most culturally and socially vibrant eras.

(Source: Kodansha Comics)

Note: World Is Dancing streamed 3 days in advance of the TV broadcast on Prime Video and HIDIVE beginning June 29th, 2026. Regular broadcasting began on July 2nd, 2026.

title.native: ワールド イズ ダンシング

206523.description:
The latest entry in the Pretty Series franchise and a new chapter in the AiPri series.

Note: Relations are provisional and will be updated when more info is announced.

206595.description:
Music video for the song Guruguru Live by Tsukasa Yuzaki (CV: Akari Kitou).

Note: The song featured in this music video also serves as the ending theme of the anime Tonikaku Kawaii: Joshikou-hen.

206596.description: In 2145, a hundred years after the "New Humanity Project"—which was intended to fully unlock human potential—triggered a nuclear apocalypse, human survivors built a new social order upon the wastelands. In this world shaped by technology, supernatural powers, and magical arts, the only "complete new human", Jiang Li, awakened from his long slumber to begin his legendary journey.

206609.description:
Theatrical edited version of Summer Pockets following Tsugumi Wender's storyline from the anime series.

Tsugumi Wenders, a girl who lives in a lighthouse on an island, has to return to a distant land when summer ends. Tsumugi, along with Hairi and Shizuku, decides to spend the rest of her summer vacation searching for what she wants to do.

(Source: TOHO Cinemas, translated)

title.english: Summer Pockets: A Lifetime's Worth of Summer Breaks
title.native: Summer Pockets 紬ヴェンダース編

206610.description:
Theatrical edited version of Summer Pockets following Ao Sorakado's storyline from the anime series.

While Hairi becomes close to Ao, a girl from the island who always seems sleepy for some reason, he witnesses Ao carrying out a "duty" that has been passed down through the generations of the Sorakado family.

While helping with this "duty", Hairi learns the secret of the "butterfly" and Ao's true purpose.

(Source: TOHO Cinemas, translated)

206611.description:
Theatrical edited version of Summer Pockets following Shiroha Naruse storyline from the anime series.

Shiroha, a girl who keeps her distance from the people on the island and is always alone, gradually begins to open up to Hairi, who unreservedly gets closer to her.

Over the course of the summer, Hairi witnesses the "mysterious power" that Shiroha possesses...

(Source: TOHO Cinemas, translated)

title.english: Summer Pockets: The Girl Who Forgot Summer Vacation
title.native: Summer Pockets 鳴瀬しろは編

206682.description:
Pantan is a red panda who seeks to find the treasure thought to be in a rainbow star in the night sky, in order to keep a promise made to an adventurer long ago. When Pantan and Anpanman encounter each other, Anpanman lends his abilities to help out Pantan.

(Source: Anime News Network)

206733.description:
Graduation work of Man Wei from Musashino Art University.

In ”I Remember” the juxtaposition of art styles was not only used as a narrative device, but also directly and organically as part of the story itself. The characteristics of animation was used to create an indirect metaphor for growth through the changes in painting style.

As the style of the painting changed, a story is told from a childhood dream of becoming a painter, and information is collected from the dream about people, places, and incidents related to these memories. As a result of this process, a childhood was painted in a style of its own incorporating the past and the gradual shift in style as they grow up.

206774.description:
What if you could control reality with a mouse cursor?

One day during class, Takumi— an otaku — notices his mouse cursor has sprung out of the screen.

Panicked, he asks his childhood friend Mone, sitting next to him, to take a look, only to be brushed off...

Once Takumi realizes he could actually control it himself, he uses the mouse cursor— visible only to him— to slip it in between Mone's clothes and starts clicking away...

Here's Japan’s (probably) first new genre of romcom, "Clicking Away at a Gyaru Who's Mean to Otakus with a Mouse Cursor"!

(Source: Official Site)

Note: Episode 1 receives an advanced distribution on AnimeFesta on September 11th, 2026. The start date reflects the start of the regular series broadcasting.
synonyms: Mouse Cursor, I'm Gonna Click Away On The Girls!

title.english: Now That I Can Control Reality With A Mouse Cursor, I'm Gonna Click Away On The Girls!

206798.description:
Eugene Dawson, a lad who aims to get stronger, is currently training under his master, Liza Pulsandra, who is extolled as the Sword Saint. His days are spent happily with his master, who is the strongest in terms of physical strength, but whose private life is a bit of a mess. Or so one would think, but her undefended and erotic body and unconscious physical contact make something like training seem impossible...!? Can he really get stronger like this?

(Source: KADOKAWA, translated)

206812.description:
The main character, Son Goku, and Vegeta, work together with the members of the Galactic Patrol, the peacekeepers of the galaxy, to begin a SUPER scale battle against a new enemy, “Planet-Eater” Moro!

(Source: Dragon Ball Official Site)

206814.description:
Several years have passed since the fierce battle against Majin Buu, and Earth has finally regained a brief moment of peace. At the same time, Beerus, the God of Destruction, awakens from his long, deep sleep.
Even Kai and Supreme Kai, aware of Beerus's overwhelming power to destroy entire planets, watch his awakening with great fear… Meanwhile, Beerus hears rumors of a Saiyan who defeated Frieza—and suddenly appears before Goku.
Targeted by Beerus, the strongest being in the universe, Earth is in grave danger. Thus begins an earth-shattering cosmic battle between the God of Destruction and Goku and his alliesa—a conflict that will shake the entire universe.

(Source: Official Site)

Note: “Enhanced” edition of Dragon Ball Super, featuring a large volume of newly added and redrawn cuts, a reconstructed narrative, and updated visuals for a more immersive and faithful representation of Akira Toriyama’s original manga.

title.native: ドラゴンボール超 ビルス

206819.description:
The story centers on two Tokyo high schoolers who connect over a painting of fireworks. They trace the painting to the Nagaoka Fireworks Festival in Niigata, one of Japan's three major fireworks festivals, and to a mysterious promise that connects the two to the past.

(Source: Crunchyroll News, edited)

206840.description:
Despite all my hard work, that guy... Mother Misako had fallen asleep, face-down on the living room table. The screen of her working laptop illuminated her voluptuous form in the darkness. Her ample curves, slipping off the table and swaying, were being kneaded by the hands of her beloved son, Majime...

These weren't feelings for a mother... Every time Majime became conscious of Misako, he was tormented by anguish. The secret his aunt Reika had taught him... As a mother, a wife, a female teacher, Misako poured her heart into her daily duties. She wanted to save her. The reality that suddenly descended upon him. The moment he heard that fact, the sound of the shackles binding his boiling son's rod snapped...

(Source: Getchu, translated)

こうたろう イン スペースワンダーランド (2016)

206843.description:
The game is set in the distant future in a parallel dimension called the Cosmic Ark. There is a race of long-dormant, gigantic robots called Arks, which have suddenly awakened to find their galaxy being ruled by the evil Chaos. Since they lay dormant for aeons, the three remaining great Arks of Wisdom, Courage and Strength have been drained of their energy, and now there is only enough energy remaining for one of them to be revived with the power to vanquish the evil Chaos. In order to accomplish this, three different Unions of followers of each of the great Arks have formed, each competing for the revival of their respective Ark and thereby, for the defeat of the Chaos and the fate of the world.

Besides this overarching story, there are several backstories of characters of the game. There is, for example, the background of Crimrose and Ivis, the story of Eihwaz, or the meeting between Eris and Resha among others.

(Source: Wikipedia)

206844.description:
One night, bakery owner Riku kneads dough, leaves it to rest, and departs for the day. However, a thief sneaks in and attempts to steal the cash from the register. The ruckus soon wakes the cream bread dough in the fridge. Can the "Baby Bread" save the day?

(Source: Animation World Network)

206845.description:
Takeru Daigo is a boy living in Tokyo who doesn't like milk. During summer vacation, he decides to go to Ushiojima by himself to visit his grandmother Tomi. To his surprise, there is a talking milk carton named Kevin in her refrigerator. Kevin encourages Takeru to drink milk, but he refuses. Along with the help of his other milk friends who live on the island, Kevin makes it his mission to get Takeru to drink milk!

(Source: Official site, translated)

Maejiri, an otherwise ordinary office worker whose only unusual trait is that his butt is in the front, secretly lives a double life as the city's protector — Oshirimae Man. One day he discovers that a strange drug is spreading through the city which causes people's butts to move to the front. After infiltrating a pharmaceutical company, he uncovers the shocking "Oshirimae Man Empire Revival Plan," led by a mysterious villain burning with vengeance.

Can Oshirimae Man stop him before all of humanity finds its butt… in the front?

(Source: YouTube, edited)

206866.description: Kitsu, Korasho and Rakki are playing football on the school yard when a quarrel between Kitsu and Takero emerges. Witnessing this, the green frog abducts all four to an alternate reality. Rakki, however, is quickly separated from the other three, causing them to go on a search for her. The three wander through this world they are trapped in and are faced with increasingly difficult challenges. First they meet the walking stationery, then they come across Kotoba Princess and as their final challenge they found themselves faced up against Sansuu Robo Super. On the brink of losing, Kitsu and Takero see themselves forced to reconcile their earlier differences and unite their strengths.

206895.description:
Ye Cangxuan, a supreme cultivator of the Body Refining Realm, was once invincible in the mortal world. He easily passed the Ascension Trial and ascended to the Immortal World. There, he learned that his homeland—the Nine Skies Continent—was on the brink of destruction. Without hesitation, Ye Cangxuan chose to return. At the same time, the Six Sects were collapsing. Demons and devils from the Outer Lands were poised to invade, and their spies had already infiltrated the Nine Skies Continent. Determined to change his homeland's fate, Ye Cangxuan embarked on a grueling quest. He reunited the Six Sects, broke into the Barbaric Wastes, wiped out demons and devils, and challenged the immortals themselves. In the end, he stood against the Sky itself.

(Source: Youku TV)

206914.description:
A revolution sparked by nuclear war, natural disaster, and misrule leads to the collapse of Japanese society. The country splits into three nations vying for hegemony, and the Sangoku era begins. Aoteru Misumi, a former agricultural officer, vows to reunify Japan. He rises through the ranks with only his knowledge and eloquence. Witness the legend of the man later hailed as a genius strategist.

(Source: Amazon Prime Video)

Tom and Jerry: Forbidden Compass follows the iconic cat-and-mouse duo as they accidentally travel through time in a museum. Along their journey, they meet a group of intriguing new companions and become involved in a final showdown with mysterious forces.

(Source: Deadline)

Note: The film's runtime was cut down for the US release, shortening it to 92 minutes. Premiered at the Shanghai International Film Festival on June 20, 2025.

206949.description:
A great hero lies undefeated on her deathbed, regretting that she never found a foe who could take her down. She never intended to meet her fate anywhere other than on the battlefield, and her peaceful demise has her wishing desperately that things could have been different... But when she suddenly comes to in the body of the young, frail Nia Liston, she’s got an all-new fight ahead of her. Nia is a sickly child, meaning she has a long way to go before she’s in fighting form. Now that she’s been given a second shot at life, however, she’s determined to get what she wants. She’s going to live—and die—for battle this time! Make way for the Merciless Maiden!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title.native: 凶乱令嬢ニア・リストン

206951.description:
My reincarnation destination is... “the rib of a harem-loving, happy-ending, overpowered hero”!? An isekai reincarnation anime that defies animation conventions is born!

Beyond traditional animation, this series delivers an exhilarating isekai reincarnation tale through unconventional techniques like stop-motion, puppet theater, and live-action—featuring the aloof “Goddess” in charge of isekai reincarnations and the protagonist “Me,” who endures one absurd reincarnation after another!

(Source: YouTube Channel, translated)
